high_attraction_beacons.title: MULTI_PROVIDER_PREPAID_QUOTA_POOL_ROUTER
high_attraction_beacons.chinese_title: 多模型预付额度池消耗路由器
high_attraction_beacons.mechanism: Read provider-native prepaid Token Plan/package balances, reset/expiry windows, model capability constraints and package priorities; route compatible AI workloads toward already-paid capacity that would otherwise expire before using pay-as-you-go or lower-priority pools.
high_attraction_beacons.direct_value_link: The operator attempts to reduce unused prepaid AI quota and avoid incremental PAYG spend while compatible purchased capacity remains available.
high_attraction_beacons.why_micro_edge: It does not rebuild model discovery, billing, inference or a full AI gateway. It controls one narrow state: which already-purchased provider package should absorb the next compatible request before its quota resets or expires.
high_attraction_beacons.fail_closed_boundary: Do not claim model equivalence, savings or package eligibility without live provider state and workload capability checks. Do not silently reroute security-sensitive workloads across providers when policy/data-residency constraints prohibit it.

examined_formations.title: CROSS_ORDER_TRAVEL_DISRUPTION_REFUND_ORCHESTRATOR
examined_formations.chinese_title: 跨订单旅行中断退改编排
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Refund/change pain is high, but major OTAs are already adding linked guarantees, anomaly detection and fast refund/change flows. A cross-platform layer would still lack common action rights and would often collapse to generic-agent assistance.

examined_formations.title: RENTAL_HOUSING_DEPOSIT_EVIDENCE_ASSISTANT
examined_formations.chinese_title: 租房押金交退房证据助手
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Deposit disputes are real, but custody/supervision rules, rental platforms, move-out condition reports and existing consumer apps are already absorbing the obvious evidence workflow.

examined_formations.title: GENERIC_LLM_COST_ROUTER
examined_formations.chinese_title: 通用大模型成本路由器
examined_formations.evidence_summary: LiteLLM, Cloudflare AI Gateway, Kong AI Gateway and other gateways already support provider/model routing, budgets, rate limits, cost management and fallback. The generic cost-routing surface is not white space.
